title: A Caterpillar Lives in Our Garden
summary: A fat, happy caterpillar lives in our garden and eats all day long, in the sun and in the rain. Only Mom isn't so happy, and soon you'll find out why.
pages: A caterpillar lives in our garden. He eats all day long.
He eats when the sun shines.
He eats the corn in Mom's garden.
